## Rule

Categorize enclosed cells by minimum bounding-box size. Given a foreground mask (`enclosed`), intersect it with morphological kernels to identify which cells are inside at least a 3×3 solid square (`is_3x3`), a 2×2 square but not 3×3 (`is_2x2`), or only a 1×1 cell (`is_1x1`). Background channel `out_c0` = grid_mask minus all non-background enclosed cells. Output has one channel per category.

## Algorithm sketch

```
# 33 nodes, opset=11. Crops internally to [1,10,12,12].
enclosed     = <morphological fill result>           # [1,1,12,12]
in_3x3_region = <Conv 3x3 ones, threshold>          # [1,1,12,12]
in_2x2_region = <Conv 2x2 ones, threshold>          # [1,1,12,12]

is_3x3     = Mul(enclosed, in_3x3_region)           # cells inside ≥3x3 block
in_2x2_enc = Mul(enclosed, in_2x2_region)           # cells inside ≥2x2 block
is_2x2_only = Sub(in_2x2_enc, is_3x3)              # ≥2x2 but not ≥3x3  (always ≥0)
is_2x2      = Relu(is_2x2_only)                    # [NO-OP]
is_1x1_only = Sub(enclosed, in_2x2_enc)            # enclosed but not ≥2x2 (always ≥0)
is_1x1      = Relu(is_1x1_only)                    # [NO-OP]

bg_c   = Sub(grid_mask, is_3x3+is_2x2+is_1x1)     # background channel
out_c0 = Sub(bg_c, ...)                            # always ≥0
out_c0_relu = Relu(out_c0)                         # [NO-OP]

output = Concat([out_c0_relu, is_1x1, is_2x2, is_3x3, ...]) -> Pad -> [1,10,30,30]
```

## Cost analysis

Live cost 28829 (memory=28800, params=29). Model crops internally to [1,10,12,12]; the one [1,...,30,30] intermediate is the output tensor, not a processing intermediate — crop_to_size_advisory -30240 is a false positive. Dominant cost: 12×12=144 cells × ~200B per intermediate × many nodes. The 3 Relu nodes (nodes 22, 24, 29) are no-ops because their inputs are provably non-negative: (1) in_3x3_region ⊆ in_2x2_region (more restrictive criteria → is_3x3 ≤ in_2x2_enc), so Sub ≥ 0; (2) in_2x2_enc ⊆ enclosed by construction, so enclosed − in_2x2_enc ≥ 0; (3) out_c0 ≥ 0 because enclosed ⊆ bg_a. Dropping the 3 Relu nodes removes 3 × 576B = 1728B.
